== Summary ==
Star Trek CCG Team Event winners: The Big Goodbye, from Minnesota. l. to r. - Nat Kirkton, Mike Harrington, Kris Sonsteby and Dan Bell. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
